verify_detail: rrectness/data-integrity bug in the most central flow in the app. #2 and #3 are a silently-swallowed failure and a user-visible freeze, respectively — both are classic "would get escalated by users in week one" bugs. #4–#6 mean three of five top-level sections (Catalog, Checkout) have dead or broken controls.
